candidate.trigger: Run Playwright administration tests with the image-backed server while the detached inner service has not bound its listener.
candidate.pathToEffect: The effective Playwright readiness request can receive an acceptable local response from the outer bridge while the inner service remains unavailable.
candidate.impact: The first test can begin before the inner server is ready and its first proxied operation can fail.

evidence.head: 9988e44849a9c50a11718aecf88fddddf3e6082d
evidence.text:
with:
          run_install: false
          cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --filter @domus/frontend exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Execute administration in the actual isolated image from Chromium
        env:
          DOMUS_BROWSER_IMAGE: domus-app-ci
          DOMUS_TEST_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          DOMUS_TEST_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: >-
          pnpm --filter @domus/frontend exec playwright test
          -c playwright.entry.config.ts tests/e2e/administration.spec.ts
          --grep 'HADW-0[1245]:'
